AI Video Letter Maker 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches a cloud-based tool to convert text or image letters into animated 1080p video messages.
- Supports MP4, MOV, JPG, and PNG uploads up to 200MB; returns videos in about 1–2 minutes.
- Handles setup and session authentication automatically; 100 free credits for new anonymous users.
- Exposes quick actions for exporting, checking credits, uploading, and tracking job status.
- Includes workflows for editing, iterative refinement, and batch processing of video letters.
